description: Figure 6 shows the distribution of data sources in the combined training and AttrEval-Simulation sets. The data sources are represented by different colors in the pie chart. The largest segment is 'EntityQuest' with 34.2%, followed by 'Hotroga' with 22.7%, 'Popora' with 20.7%, 'TREC' with 1.7%, 'Webquest' with 3.6%, and 'TRI' with 0.1%. The pie chart does not include a legend, and the segments are not visually emphasized in any way.
